metadata_before.name: Multiple Dwelling Registrations
metadata_before.attribution: Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD)
metadata_before.description:
Pursuant to New York City’s Housing Maintenance Code, the Department of Housing 
Preservation and Development (HPD) collects registration information from owners of 
residential rental units. Owners are required to register if they own residential buildings 
with three or more units or if they own one- or two-family homes and neither they nor 
members of their immediate family live there. Registrations are required upon taking 
ownership of a qualifying building, and once a year thereafter.

columns.name: BuildingID
columns.description: Unique identifier of building being registered

columns.name: Boro
columns.description: Boro code (1 = Manhattan, 2 = Bronx, 3 = Brooklyn, 4 = Queens, 5 = Staten Island)

columns.name: BIN
columns.description: DCP Building Identification Number for building

columns.name: LastRegistrationDate
columns.description: Date on which the registration information was processed

Dataset Information.Agency: Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD)

tags: department of housing preservation and development
